title: On the Recall Scaling Laws in Mamba: A Theoretical and Mechanistic Study via Hashing
abstract: arXiv:2609.07681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Associative Recall (AR) is the cognitive ability to learn and retrieve links between items in memory. In NLP, AR is used as a benchmark for evaluating the in-context memory capacity of architectures such as Mamba, and has been found to strongly correlate with language modeling performance. This paper explores AR from the perspective of mechanistic interpretability, aiming to reverse-engineer the exact internal algorithm used by Mamba to perform recall. Our key insight is that Mamba performs recall by implicitly learning linear hash functions, and we identify the low-level circuit that enables this behavior. Building on these findings and inspired by theoretical tools in similarity-preserving hashing, such as the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma, we develop a theoretical framework for analyzing AR, which we term Recall Scaling Laws. translated_title: 关于Mamba中回忆缩放定律的研究：基于哈希的理论与机制性研究
translated_abstract: 关联回忆是一种学习和检索记忆中项目之间联系的认知能力。在自然语言处理中，关联回忆被用作评估Mamba等架构的上下文记忆能力的基准，并且被发现与语言建模性能强相关。本文从机制可解释性的角度探讨关联回忆，旨在逆向工程Mamba执行回忆时所使用的确切内部算法。我们的关键洞察是，Mamba通过隐式学习线性哈希函数来执行回忆，并且我们识别了实现这一行为的底层电路。基于这些发现，并受到相似性保持哈希理论工具（如Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理）的启发，我们开发了一个用于分析关联回忆的理论框架，我们称之为回忆缩放定律。给定词表大小和上下文中事实的数量，该框架使我们能够（1）预测嵌入……
tldr: 本文通过机制可解释性研究揭示Mamba通过隐式学习线性哈希函数来执行关联回忆，并借助Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理等相似性保持哈希理论工具，提出了可预测其上下文记忆能力的“回忆缩放定律”理论框架。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through mechanistic interpretability that Mamba performs associative recall by implicitly learning linear hash functions, and develops a "Recall Scaling Laws" theoretical framework, inspired by similarity-preserving hashing tools such as the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma, to predict its in-context memory capacity.
